The '''SI 5g7 "Quickscan" imaging system''' was manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. The unit could be found on the [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]/[[Bomber/Legends|bomber]], where it was linked to the [[ANc 2.7 tracking computer/Legends|ANc 2.7 tracking computer]].
